searchText: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/issues/3079 issue to discuss bounding the length of the validator scan per block this is the last thing i think is important to consider before "feature freezing withdrawals" https://notes.ethereum.org/@ralexstokes/B1RlKlXBj ^ notes on extending the `staking-cli` to support `capella` withdrawal credential changes You may or may not care, but `ethdo` already has this functionality https://github.com/wealdtech/ethdo/blob/master/docs/changingwithdrawalcredentials.md excellent! i still think we want to extend the `staking-cli` as a form of "offical" support for this use case When I deposited I was very thankful that there were two independent implementations that computed the deposit data. I verified 1000 times that the deposit-cli and ethdo returned the same values and both recovered the same accounts from the given mnemonic. I'll surely appreciate this again for withrawals
